nodes.label: Markdown Note Editor capability (archived spec)
nodes.rationale: Popup editor provides a formatting toolbar (bold, italic, heading, list, link, code, blockquote) that inserts markdown syntax at the cursor or around selected text; when importing AI notes the editor pre-fills the full LLM response with a blank line at top for the user, cursor placed there; Save persists markdown to the specific move, Cancel discards changes; markdown chosen over WYSIWYG rich text to keep storage portable and exportable.
